blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: State-of-the-art feedforward reconstruction models perform poorly on in-the-wild object-centric photo collections. They are trained largely on single-session object captures whose images vary in viewpoint while the object and its environment remain nearly fixed. Public photo archives contain a different form of multi-view data. They hold found photos of the same object or design: photos taken independently by many people across years, environments, cameras, and sometimes physical units. In this work, we introduce Trainspotting, a dataset of 12,068 objects and 311,886 photos from Wikimedia Commons. We reconstruct each object to recover camera poses, multi-view stereo depth, and object masks. We categorize the objects into three regimes: objects fixed at one site, objects that move between sites, and designs shared by many physical units. Evaluating recent feedforward reconstruction models on Trainspotting shows that they fail most severely in the last two regimes. Fine-tuning VGGT-$Ω$ on Trainspotting significantly improves camera pose, depth, and 3D geometry on held-out objects. We observe similar improvements on the independent NAVI in-the-wild benchmark, which contains photos of each object in different environments. Performance on conventional benchmarks remains largely unchanged.

blocks.en:
The photos of an object on Wikimedia Commons follow no shared capture plan.
Their viewpoints are unevenly sampled, and their environment may change dramatically from one photo to the next (e.g., a ship on the open seas vs. the same ship in port).
An individual object may be repainted or rebuilt over time, and photos of a mass-produced product, like a specific make and model of car, may depict different physical instances.
Datasets of landmarks and other places have been built from similar in-the-wild Internet photo collections [ 38 , 24 , 42 ] .
However, these scene-level photo collections depict a largely consistent physical space, whereas photos of an object often share only the object itself in many different contexts and times.
Figure 1 shows an example of such photos, depicting the locomotive Flying Scotsman captured over a century in many different locations.

blocks.en:
Standard reconstruction pipelines are unreliable in such in-the-wild settings, and so are feedforward reconstruction models, which are largely trained on their output (Figure 2 ).
Classical structure from motion relies on repeatable correspondences that agree with one rigid scene [ 35 ] .
A changing environment provides few such correspondences, and the object may occupy only a small part of each photo.
Changes to an individual object over time and differences between physical units further weaken geometric consistency.
Together, these factors can result in incorrect reconstructions, so building a dataset from these photos requires identifying the photos of the intended object, matching them robustly, and verifying the recovered geometry.

blocks.en:
In this work, we propose a dataset and an evaluation protocol for feedforward reconstruction of objects from in-the-wild photo collections.
To build this dataset, we collect candidate categories from Wikidata and Wikimedia Commons, such as Cristo Redentor , the Hubble Space Telescope , and the Ford Mustang .
We use a large language model (LLM) to retain the categories that depict a rigid physical object or design (Section 3 ).
To address the failures of standard pipelines on these collections, we propose a new object reconstruction pipeline, combining dense learned matching with geometric verification of the recovered camera poses and depth maps (Section 4 ).
The result of our pipeline is Trainspotting , an in-the-wild object-centric dataset that contains 12,068 objects and 311,886 photos from Wikimedia Commons paired with camera poses, MVS depth, and object masks.
An example reconstruction of the Flying Scotsman is shown on the right of Figure 1 .

We evaluate recent feedforward reconstruction models on Trainspotting and find that they perform substantially worse on these in-the-wild collections than on conventional benchmarks.
Therefore, we fine-tune one such model, VGGT- Ω \Omega , on Trainspotting and show that the resulting model, Spotter , significantly improves camera pose, depth, and 3D geometry on these objects, raising camera-pose AUC@30 from 25 to 81 on held-out objects and from 19 to 76 on NAVI in-the-wild [ 19 ] , an independent benchmark of objects photographed across different environments, while performance on conventional benchmarks is largely retained.
Together, these results suggest that Trainspotting can help feedforward reconstruction models generalize to the real-world diversity of object photos.

blocks.en:
3D datasets. 3D datasets have grown rapidly in scale.
Synthetic datasets such as Objaverse [ 10 , 9 ] and ShapeNet [ 7 ] provide textured 3D models.
Datasets built with 3D scanners include DTU [ 1 ] , Google Scanned Objects [ 12 ] , and OmniObject3D [ 53 ] , and contain at most a few thousand objects.
Meanwhile, CO3D [ 31 ] , MVImgNet [ 62 , 54 ] , and uCO3D [ 28 ] reach a larger scale by crowdsourcing videos of objects and annotating them with 3D information via structure from motion.
In such datasets, each object is recorded in one coordinated capture [ 31 , 62 , 28 , 55 ] .
ScanNet [ 8 ] , ScanNet++ [ 61 ] , and DL3DV [ 27 ] record scenes in the same way.
Few datasets photograph objects in different environments.
PASCAL3D+ [ 56 ] , ObjectNet3D [ 57 ] , and Pix3D [ 40 ] align CAD models to internet images of objects, but the models only approximate the depicted objects.
NAVI [ 19 ] is the closest dataset to our setting.
It photographs each object in different environments with different cameras and aligns each image to a 3D scan of that object.
In all of these object-scale datasets, each image is aligned to its corresponding 3D model by hand, and per-image geometry such as depth is rendered from that model rather than reconstructed from the photos.
In contrast, Trainspotting consists of multi-view photo collections of objects taken by different people over many years, with camera poses and depth recovered by an automated reconstruction pipeline, and is much larger than NAVI.
Table 1 compares Trainspotting with other datasets of real images used for 3D reconstruction.

Reconstruction from internet photo collections. Photo Tourism [ 38 ] and Building Rome in a Day [ 2 ] reconstructed landmarks from unordered photos taken by many photographers.
Later datasets use such reconstructions as supervision for learned models.
MegaDepth [ 24 ] reconstructs about 200 landmarks from photos on Flickr with COLMAP [ 35 ] , filters the resulting multi-view stereo depth, and uses it to supervise single-view depth prediction.
MegaScenes [ 42 ] reconstructs
80k Wikimedia Commons categories of scenes
with COLMAP using
SIFT features.
MegaDepth-X [ 23 ] selects densely photographed MegaScenes scenes and reconstructs them with MASt3R-SfM [ 13 ] and doppelganger disambiguation [ 58 ] .
All three contain scene-level rather than object-centric reconstructions.
Of the 12,068 objects in Trainspotting , only 1,163 (9.6%) are reconstructed as scenes in MegaScenes and 56 (0.5%) in MegaDepth-X, almost all of them objects permanently installed at one site, such as statues and memorials.
Objects that move between sites or exist as many physical units are almost entirely absent from these datasets.

blocks.en:
Learned matching and structure from motion. Classical structure from motion (SfM) methods like
COLMAP [ 35 ] match hand-crafted
keypoints
and register images incrementally.
SuperPoint [ 11 ] and SuperGlue [ 34 ] replace traditional keypoint detection and matching with learned components.
LoFTR [ 39 ] proposes detector-free matching, predicting matches directly with a transformer.
Dense matchers such as DKM [ 14 ] , RoMa [ 15 ] , and RoMa v2 [ 16 ] predict a warp for every pixel of an image pair, aiming to recover correspondences under large changes in viewpoint and illumination.
Several SfM systems, such as Detector-Free SfM [ 18 ] and Dense-SfM [ 21 ] , build on such dense matches to form multi-view tracks and refine the tracks together with the geometry.
MASt3R-SfM [ 13 ] builds on the matches of MASt3R [ 22 ] and jointly aligns all images.
VGGSfM [ 47 ] learns the entire reconstruction pipeline, predicting tracks, cameras, and points and refining them with differentiable bundle adjustment.
We keep the incremental reconstruction of COLMAP and supply it with multi-view tracks built from RoMa v2 matches that pass confidence and geometric checks (Section 4 ).

blocks.en:
Feedforward 3D reconstruction. Feedforward models that regress cameras, depth, and point maps directly from a set of images have become a standard approach to 3D reconstruction [ 51 , 22 , 59 , 41 , 64 , 48 , 52 , 25 , 20 , 49 ] .
Most of their object-level training data come from single-session captures and renderings of synthetic 3D assets.
They are likewise evaluated on benchmarks built with such data.
Two recent works, MegaDepth-X [ 23 ] and MegaUnScene [ 65 ] train and evaluate feedforward models on in-the-wild internet photo collections, but only on scene-level, not object-centric, collections. Trainspotting is an object-level dataset similarly built from internet photos.
We fine-tune VGGT- Ω \Omega on this dataset and compare the result with recent feedforward models on Trainspotting and NAVI in-the-wild (Section 5 ).
blocks.zh:
FeedForward 3D重建项目. FeedForward模型直接从一组图像中递归相机,深度和点图,成为3D重建的标准方法[51,22,59,41,64,48,52,25,20,49].
他们的大部分对象级训练数据来自合成3D资产的单会场捕捉和渲染.
同样,也根据利用这些数据建立的基准来评价这些基准。
最近两部作品,Mega Depth-X [23] 和MegaUnScene [65] 培训并评价网内图片集的feedforward models,但只在场景层面,而不是以对象为中心的,收藏. Trainspotting是一个类似由互联网照片构建的对象级数据集.
我们在此数据集上微调 VGGT - 堆积 \ Omega , 并将结果与最近关于列车投注和NAVI的输入模型(第5节)进行比较。

blocks.en: 3 The Trainspotting Dataset
blocks.zh: 3 列车定点数据集

blocks.en:
Trainspotting is a dataset of objects reconstructed from Wikimedia Commons photos taken by many people over many years.
It contains many types of rigid objects (Table 2 ), including statues, cannons, pipe organs, telephone boxes, fountains, cameras, ships, aircraft, and locomotives.
This section describes how our dataset is curated from Internet sources, and Section 4 describes how we reconstruct the individual objects.

blocks.en: 3.1 Objects from Wikimedia Commons
blocks.zh: 3.1 来自维基媒体的天体

blocks.en:
Wikimedia Commons organizes photos into user-curated categories.
Categories for physical subjects are often specific to one object or design, such as Category:LNER Class A3 4472 Flying Scotsman .
Each object in Trainspotting corresponds to one such category, and we call the images filed under it a collection .
Many of these categories are linked from Wikidata, the structured knowledge base supporting Wikimedia projects, and 68% of the Trainspotting objects have a Wikidata item.
blocks.zh:
Wikimedia Communitys将照片组织成用户验证的类别.
物理主体的类别往往针对一个物体或设计,例如: LNER级A3 4472飞苏格兰人.
Trainspotting中的每个对象都对应一个这样的类别,我们称其下存档的图像为集合.
其中很多类别都与维基数据相关联,是支持维基媒体项目的结构化知识库,68%的Trainspoting对象拥有维基数据项.

blocks.en:
Objects represent either individuals or designs.
An individual is a single physical unit, such as one hull, one statue, or one numbered locomotive.
A design is a shape shared by many physical units, such as a car model or a mass-produced telephone box with the same underlying geometry.
We pool all units of a design into one single collection, where individual units within the collection may differ in color, trim, and wear.
blocks.zh:
物体代表个人或设计。
个人是单一的物理单元,如一个船体,一个雕像,或者一个编号的机车.
一个设计是一个由许多物理单元共享的形状,例如汽车模型或质量生产的具有同样基础几何的电话盒.
我们把所有的设计单位集中到一个单一的集合中,其中集合中的单个单位在颜色,修饰和穿戴上可能有所不同.

blocks.en: 3.2 Curation at scale
blocks.zh: 3.2 规模说明

blocks.en:
We enumerate candidate categories in two ways.
Some classes, such as ships and locomotives, are enumerated from their Wikidata items; others are found by traversing the Wikimedia Commons category graph from root categories, such as Cameras and Pipe organs .
The traversal records 155,744 categories after excluding branches that do not depict the object itself, such as photos taken with a camera model, drawings, and replicas of an object.
blocks.zh:
我们以两种方式列出候选类别。
一些类别,如舰船和机车,从其维基数据项中列出;其他类别则通过从根类中翻转维基媒体Commons分类图来发现,如相机和管道器官. .
曲面记录了155,744个类别,不包括不描绘物体本身的分支,如用照相机模型拍摄的照片,图画,以及物体的复制品.

blocks.en:
The traversal also reaches subcategories for places, events, and parts related to an object, which we wish to exclude.
Title rules cannot reliably separate these categories from the objects themselves.
For example, Cannon Street station is a railway station rather than a cannon.
Therefore, we use an LLM to classify each of the recorded categories from its title and the categories above it in the category graph.
The classifier assigns three labels: (i) whether the category depicts a rigid physical object, which decides whether it is kept; (ii) whether it names an individual or a design; and (iii) whether the object is permanently installed at one site.
Labels (ii) and (iii) determine the regime of each object (Section 3.3 ).
Together with the Wikidata-enumerated classes, the categories kept by the classifier yield 33,884 candidate objects, of which we attempt to reconstruct 17,470 after filtering on the number of photos.
blocks.zh:
与物体有关的地点、事件和部件也属于亚类,我们希望将其排除在外。
标题规则不能可靠地将这些类别与对象本身分开。
例如,坎农街站是一个火车站而不是炮台.
因此,我们使用一个LLM从标题中将每个记录的类别分类,并在分类图中将其以上类别分类.
分类器分配三个标签: (一)分类是否描绘一个刚性物理物体,由它决定它是否保存; (二)它是否命名个人或设计; (三)该物体是否永久安装在一个站点.
标签(二)和(三)确定每个物体的制度(第3.3节)。
与Wikidata-假设类一起,分类器所保存的类别产生33,884个候选对象,其中我们试图在过滤照片数量后重建17,470个.

blocks.en:
This curation alone does not filter individual images by their visual content.
Collections retain cluttered
photos, partial views, and images in which the object occupies a small part of the frame.
We rely on the robust downstream reconstruction pipeline to either register these images in 3D or remove them when they cannot be registered correctly (Section 4 ).
blocks.zh:
仅此而已,不能通过视觉内容过滤个人图像。
收藏保留杂乱
图片、部分视图以及物体占据框架一小部分的图像。
我们依靠强大的下游重建管道,要么将这些图像用3D记录下来,要么在无法正确登记时将其删除(第4节)。

blocks.en: 3.3 Capture variation
blocks.zh: 3.3 国家 捕捉变化

blocks.en:

blocks.en:
Different kinds of objects are characterized by different forms of variation in context and capture.
A statue fixed to its plinth yields photos that share a common environment, but differ in viewpoint, time, and lighting.
Photos of a locomotive span different stations with corresponding changes in the environment.
A telephone-box design represents many physical units whose exact wear and paint may differ.
We denote these distinct categories as fixed , roaming , and instance-pooled (Figure 3 ). Fixed denotes an individual installed at one site, roaming an individual that moves between sites, and instance-pooled a design shared by many physical instances.
The labels follow from LLM classification (Section 3.2 ) and are therefore approximate.
blocks.zh:
不同种类的物体的特点是上下文和捕捉的不同形式变化.
雕像固定在柱子上,
机车照片横跨不同车站,环境也相应变化.
电话箱设计代表许多物理单元,其准确磨损和油漆可能有所不同。
我们将这些不同的类别表示为固定的、漫游的和集合的(图3)。 固定表示一个安装在一个站点的个人,在站点之间移动的个人漫游,实例集合了许多物理实例共享的设计.
这些标签来自LLM分类(第3.2节),因此是大致的。

blocks.en: 4 Pseudo-Ground Truth via Reconstruction
blocks.zh: 4 通过重建查明真相

blocks.en:
A Wikimedia Commons category can contain photos of other objects of the same kind, unrelated subjects, and crowded scenes in which the object is small.
In this section, we describe how we robustly reconstruct each object to obtain camera poses, MVS depth, and object masks via object gating, learned dense matching, and geometric verification.
Figure 4 follows one object through the reconstruction pipeline.
blocks.zh:
一个Wikimedia Communications分类可以包含其他同类对象的照片,无关主题,以及物体小的拥挤场景.
在本节中,我们描述了我们如何大力重建每个物体,以通过物体的标注、学习到的密集匹配和几何校验获得相机姿势、MVS深度和物体面具。
图4是通过重建管道跟踪一个物体。

blocks.en: 4.1 Matching and structure from motion
blocks.zh: 4.1 运动的匹配和结构

blocks.en:
Object gating. We use an LLM to assign a text prompt to each object, similar to the classification in Section 3.2 .
We then use SAM3 [ 6 ] with this prompt to identify images in which the object is the main subject.
We keep an image when the largest detected box covers at least 10% of the image.
Common rejected images include crowd photos, close-ups of details, and images of a different subject filed in the same category.
blocks.zh:
物体钓鱼。 我们使用LLM为每个对象指定一个文本提示,类似于第3.2节中的分类.
然后我们用 SAM3 [6] 用这个提示来识别以对象为主体的图像.
当最大检测到的盒子覆盖至少10%的图像时,我们保留一个图像.
常见的被拒绝图像包括人群照片,细节的特写,以及在同一类别存档的不同主题的图像.

blocks.en:
Dense matching. We compute point matches between photos with the dense matcher RoMa v2 [ 16 ] due to its robustness to environment and object variation.
In the supplement, we compare this choice with structure from motion from SIFT, SuperPoint with LightGlue, and MASt3R matches on the same images.
We embed each image with the retrieval model of MASt3R-SfM [ 13 ] and match it against the 20 closest images in the embedding space.
For each image pair, RoMa v2 returns a dense mapping of every pixel of one image to the other along with a certainty map.
We sample candidate correspondences from these outputs.

These shared keypoints link pairwise matches into multi-view tracks.

blocks.zh: 4.2 MVS深度和口罩

blocks.en:
Figure 6 : Qualitative comparison. We visualize ground truth and predicted camera poses and point maps from π 3 \pi^{3} [ 52 ] , Depth Anything 3 [ 25 ] , VGGT- Ω \Omega [ 49 ] , and Spotter on held out objects from Trainspotting and NAVI in-the-wild [ 19 ] . We use 4 or 16 input views for Trainspotting and 8 for NAVI in-the-wild. Only the first 4 input views are shown. Triangular markers indicate the directions of the cameras outside of the frame.
The baselines misregister the input views and produce duplicated or fragmented geometry, whereas Spotter recovers a single consistent object and accurate camera poses.

View selection. A mis-registered view, or a view of a different object weakly linked to the reconstruction, is unreliable as ground truth and can corrupt the depth of its neighbors during MVS.
Therefore, we keep a view only if enough of its points have a track length of at least three.
We then build a covisibility graph in which two views are connected by an edge weighted by the number of 3D points they share.
We split this graph by spectral bisection and discard the smaller subgraph when the conductance of the cut is below 0.15.

查看选择。 错误注册的视图,或与重建联系微弱的不同物体的视图,作为地面真理是不可靠的,在MVS期间可能会腐蚀其邻居的深度.
因此,只有当其足够多的要点至少有3个轨道长度时,我们才保持观点。
然后我们绘制一个可视化图,其中两个视图通过以它们共享的3D点数加权的边连接.
我们用光谱分解这个图,当剪切的导线低于0.15时,将较小的子图丢弃.

blocks.en:
Multi-view stereo with a monocular check. We run Cas-DiffMVS [ 44 ] on the selected views and keep high-confidence depths.
Since MVS can be unreliable on textureless and specular surfaces, we verify these depths against a monocular depth prediction from MoGe-2 [ 50 ] , as in MegaDepth-X [ 23 ] , using the spherical filtering strategy of MoGe-2 and ViGeo [ 50 , 63 ] .
blocks.zh:
多视立体声带单视检查. 我们运行 Cas-DiffMVS [44] 在选定的视图上保持高度自信深度.
由于MVS在无纹理和光谱表面上可能不可靠,我们用MoGe-2[50]的单光谱深度预测来验证这些深度,如MegaDepth-X[23],使用MoGe-2和ViGeo[50,63]的球状过滤策略.

blocks.en:
Object masks. We select the SAM3 mask that covers the largest share of the verified depth as the target object mask.
A photo is included only if enough of the selected mask carries verified depth.
A final quality check removes objects with erroneous reconstructions and photos with implausible focal lengths or in which the object is not the dominant subject.
blocks.zh:

照片只包含在所选口罩中足够带有经核实的深度的情况下。
最终的质量检查会删除重建错误的对象和焦距不可信或对象不是主对象的照片.

blocks.en: 4.3 Statistics
blocks.zh: 4.3 统计

blocks.en:
We pass 17,470 objects with 1,251,986 photos through our reconstruction pipeline.
We report the number of objects and photos that remain after each stage in the supplement.
Object gating removes the largest share of photos.
Structure from motion succeeds for 85% of the objects and registers 72% of the gated photos.

我们报告在补编的每个阶段之后留下的物体和照片的数目。

blocks.en:
Dataset. Our final dataset, Trainspotting , contains 12,068 objects and 311,886 photos.
Out of all of its objects, 4,338 are fixed, 2,869 roaming, and 4,861 instance-pooled.
Capture dates are available for 84% of the photos. The median capture span is 12 years and 90% of the objects have a capture span of at least one year.
A median object has photos by 7 different photographers taken with 6 different camera models.
Figure 5 shows these distributions by regime.
For a coarse view of the composition, we use an LLM to group the 337 object labels of the dataset into 53 categories and 13 supercategories (Table 2 ).
We release Trainspotting with its camera poses, MVS depth, and object masks.
Every photo is distributed with its Wikimedia Commons source, author, and licence.

Model and training. We obtain Spotter by fine-tuning the released 1B-parameter checkpoint of VGGT- Ω \Omega [ 49 ] on the training objects of Trainspotting .
We update the camera head and all attention blocks of the transformer backbone.
Each training sample contains one object and between 2 and 24 of its photos, chosen so that they form a connected set under covisibility.
We consider two photos covisible when at least 5% of the object points of one project inside the object mask of the other.

每个训练样本都包含一个对象及其2至24个照片,选择后形成可视性下的连接集.
我们认为,当一个工程的至少5%的物体点位于另一个工程的物体遮盖内时,有两张照片可以隐形。

VGGT- Ω \Omega performs considerably better on fixed objects than on the other two regimes, whereas Spotter performs similarly on all three, and performance further improves with more views.

The baselines fail to register views taken in different environments.
Their point maps therefore contain duplicated or fragmented copies of the object, and their cameras are scattered. Spotter registers the same views consistently and reconstructs a single object.

blocks.en: 5.4 NAVI in-the-wild
blocks.zh: 5.4 NAVI 零星

blocks.en:
The NAVI dataset [ 19 ] contains 36 objects, each with a scanned mesh and camera poses aligned to it, photographed both in multiview captures recorded in a single session and in an in-the-wild collection across different environments.
As the held-out Trainspotting results are scored against pseudo-ground truth from our own pipeline, evaluating on NAVI in-the-wild provides an independent measure of accuracy.
Under our protocol NAVI yields 35 in-the-wild and 281 multiview samples.
Tables 6 and 6 report the results.
VGGT- Ω \Omega reaches an AUC@30 of 91.6 on the multiview captures but only 18.8 on the in-the-wild collections of the same objects.
Fine-tuning on Trainspotting raises the in-the-wild AUC@30 to 76.0 and improves completeness from 20.4 to 1.9 mm. Spotter achieves the best in-the-wild result on every metric except accuracy, on which all models lie within 1 mm of one another.
We note that when the views of a prediction are misregistered, the similarity alignment scales the prediction down toward the center of the object, so each predicted point stays close to the surface while most of the surface is left uncovered.
Pose failures therefore appear as completeness error rather than accuracy error.
On the multiview captures, performance is largely unchanged.

blocks.en: 5.6 Ablations
blocks.zh: 5.6 拖欠款项

blocks.en:
Table 7 compares models trained on subsets of the Trainspotting training objects.
All models in this comparison, including the reference model trained on all objects, are trained for 10 epochs with the same recipe as Spotter .
We find that the types of photos used for training matter more than their scale.
Training only on fixed objects yields lower accuracy than training on a random subset half its size, both on held-out objects and on NAVI in-the-wild.
It is also considerably less accurate on roaming and instance-pooled objects, whereas models trained on those regimes remain close to the reference model when evaluated on fixed objects.
This shows that photos across different environments, which fixed objects and existing datasets largely lack, are necessary for generalization to the other regimes and to NAVI in-the-wild.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
Current feedforward reconstruction models perform poorly on in-the-wild object-centric photo collections, even for objects that they reconstruct accurately from a single capture session.
Such in-the-wild collections are abundant in public photo archives, and Trainspotting shows that they can be turned into training data at scale.
Fine-tuning VGGT- Ω \Omega on Trainspotting improves camera pose, depth, and 3D geometry on held-out objects and on the independent NAVI in-the-wild benchmark, while performance on conventional benchmarks remains largely unchanged.
The base models had already been trained on large datasets of objects recorded in single capture sessions, and we also show that training on fixed objects alone transfers poorly to roaming and instance-pooled objects, so what these models lacked was variation in how an object is photographed.
Beyond training, Trainspotting provides a benchmark for reconstruction under changing environments, and its reconstructions of objects photographed over decades allow studying how objects and their surroundings change over time.
blocks.zh:
目前的向导重建模型在以圆形物体为中心的照片收藏上表现不佳,甚至对于它们从一个捕捉会话中准确重建的物体来说也是如此.
公共照片档案中有大量的这类藏品,Trainspoting显示,这些藏品可大规模转化为培训数据。
精细校正 VGGT – 精细校正 \ Omega 关于列车位点的校正 改进了相机在被扣物体和独立的NAVI 内置基准上的姿势,深度和3D几何,而常规基准的性能则基本保持不变.
基础模型已经接受了关于单次捕捉中记录的物体大数据集的培训,我们也表明,仅关于固定物体的训练不能很好地向漫游和实例集合物体转移,因此这些模型所缺乏的是在物体拍摄方式上的差异。
除了培训外,Trainspoting还为在不断变化的环境中进行重建提供了基准,其几十年拍摄的物体的重建可以研究物体及其周围环境如何随时间变化。

All other objects are found by traversing the Wikimedia Commons category graph from 856 root categories.
We chose 211 of them by hand, and the LLM screened the remaining 645 from the subcategories of broad hand-chosen categories.
The traversal does not descend into branches whose titles match one of seven kinds of category that do not depict the object itself: photos taken with a camera model, people with an object, media about an object, replicas and scale models, institutions, parts, and wiki maintenance categories.
It prunes 37,930 branches this way and records 155,744 categories.

Classification. Of the recorded categories, 49,252 contain at least 25 photos, counting the photos of subcategories that depict the same object.
The LLM classifies each of them from its title and the titles of the categories above it in the graph.
The prompt is reproduced in Section G .
It keeps 40,254 categories as rigid physical objects, rejects 8,956 for the reasons listed in Table S2 , and leaves 42 undecided.
Of the kept categories, 13,347 name an individual object or a design, and the remaining 26,907 are categories of many objects, such as Statues in Paris , which we do not use.
After removing categories already covered by the vehicle classes and merging subcategories that depict the same object into their parent, 10,901 object categories remain.

blocks.en: This section completes the setup of Section 5.1 of the main paper.
blocks.zh: 本节完成主要论文第5.1节的设置.

blocks.en:
Trainable parameters. We fine-tune the released VGGT- Ω \Omega checkpoint with 1B parameters.
All 24 frame and global attention layers of the aggregator and the camera head are trained, while the patch embedding, the camera and register tokens, and the depth head are frozen.
This leaves 808M of the 1.14B parameters trainable.
blocks.zh:
可训练参数. 我们用 1B 参数微调已发行的 VGGT 组合 \ Omega 检查点 。
集合器和相机头的全部24个帧和全局关注层都经过训练,而补丁嵌入,相机和寄存符,深度头则被冻结.
这留下了1.14B参数中可列车的808M.

blocks.en:
Sampling. The number of views per sample is drawn once per batch, uniformly between 2 and 24.
Each batch is filled to a fixed budget of 192 images per GPU.
Inputs follow the training preprocessing of VGGT- Ω \Omega [ 49 ] .
Depth and points are supervised only on object pixels that have MVS depth.
The replay samples from BlendedMVS, Hypersim, and uCO3D are supervised on all pixels with ground truth.
blocks.zh:
采样. 每个样本的查看次数每批一次,统一为2至24次。
每批装入固定预算每GPU192幅图像.
输入跟随 VGGT- stage\Omega [49] 的训练预处理.
深度和点只被监视在具有MVS深度的对象像素上.
BlendedMVS,Hypersim,和uCO3D的重播样本被监控在所有像素上具有地面真实性.

blocks.en:
Optimization. The cosine schedule decays the learning rate to 10 − 8 10^{-8} .
Gradients are clipped to a norm of 1.
Training uses bfloat16 precision with gradient checkpointing.
blocks.zh:
优化. 余弦表使学习率衰减到10 -8 10 -Q-8}.
梯度被剪切到1的规范.
训练使用bfloat16精确度和梯度检查。

blocks.en:
Object mask head. After fine-tuning, we freeze the model and train a small convolutional head on the fused features of its depth head to predict, for each pixel, whether it belongs to the object.
The target is the object mask of the dataset.
On held-out objects, the predicted masks reach an intersection over union of 0.92 with the dataset masks.
blocks.zh:
物体面具头. 经过微调后,我们冻结模型,并在它的深度头部的熔化特征上训练一个小的转动头,以预测每个像素是否属于对象.
目标为数据集的对象遮罩.
在被搁置的物体上,预测的口罩与数据集口罩在0.92的结合上达到交汇点.

blocks.en: This section details the protocol of Section 5.2 of the main paper.
blocks.zh: 本节详述主要文件第5.2节的规程。

blocks.en:
Samples on Trainspotting . The views of a sample form a connected set under the covisibility relation used for training: two photos are connected when at least 5% of the object points of one project inside the object mask of the other.
Each view is resized to cover 512 × 512 512\times 512 pixels and cropped around its principal point.
blocks.zh:
火车选注样本. 一个样本的视图在用于训练的可视性关系下形成一个连接的集: 当一个项目的对象点至少有5%在另一个项目的对象罩内时,两个照片被连接.
每个视图的大小被调整为覆盖512×512 512\times 512像素,并围绕其主点进行裁剪.

blocks.en:
External datasets. For ordered captures, the 8 views are equally spaced over the sequence, including its first and last frame.
For unordered collections, they are a fixed random draw.
Scenes with fewer than 8 usable frames are skipped.
On NAVI, images are center-cropped to a square, and frames that the dataset flags as occluded are excluded.
Inputs are resized to each model’s patch multiple, and outputs are resampled to the ground-truth grid.
blocks.zh:
外部数据集. 对于有秩序的捕捉,8视图在序列上,包括其第一帧和最后一帧的间距相同.
对于无序的集合,它们是一种固定的随机图.
不到8个可用框架的画面被跳过 。
在NAVI上,图像被中层拼贴到一个正方形,而框框则排除了所覆盖的数据集旗帜.
输入量被调整到每个模型的补丁的多个尺寸,输出量被重印到地面真实网格.

blocks.en:
Metrics. The depth scale of a sample is the median ratio of ground-truth to predicted depth over the valid pixels of all its views.
The similarity transform of the point-map metrics is estimated from corresponding valid pixels [ 43 ] before the ICP refinement.
blocks.zh:
度量衡. 样本的深度尺度是地面真实度与预测深度的中位数,相对于其所有观点的有效像素。
点映射度量的相似性变换是从比较方案完善前相应的有效像素[43]估算出来的.

blocks.en:
Effect of the alignment on misregistered predictions. Section 5.4 of the main paper explains why pose failures appear as completeness error rather than accuracy error.
Table S6 quantifies this on NAVI in-the-wild by the extent of the aligned prediction relative to the extent of the ground truth.
The alignment scales most predictions of VGGT- Ω \Omega to less than half the object’s size, while the predictions of Spotter keep their size.
blocks.zh:
调整对错误登记的预测的影响。 主要文件第5.4节解释了为何将失败视为完整性错误而不是准确性错误。
表S6在NAVI中按与地面真相相对应的预测程度将这一点量化。
VGGT- 堆积 \ Omega 的比对大小小于对象的一半, 而Spotter 的比对大小不变 。

blocks.en: Table S6 : Extent of the aligned prediction on NAVI in-the-wild. Ratio of the extent of the aligned prediction to the extent of the ground truth over the 35 objects, and the number of objects with a ratio below 0.7.

blocks.en: Figure S2 : Failure cases. Four held-out samples on which Spotter fails: airliner (noisy depth at long focal lengths), car (misregistered close-up of a wheel), grave monument (doppelganger ambiguity), and toy shark from NAVI in-the-wild (out of distribution).
blocks.zh: 图S2:失败案例。 Spotter失败的4个搁置的样本:飞机(长焦距的模糊深度)、汽车(错误地登记了轮子的特写)、坟墓纪念碑(二重身模糊)和NAVI的玩具鲨鱼(在分布之外)。

blocks.en:
Failure cases. Figure S2 shows four held-out samples on which Spotter fails, one for each of the most common failure modes.
Views taken with long focal lengths are ambiguous between focal length and depth, so their points can be misaligned with the other views and appear as noise around the airliner.
Close-up views can be ambiguous in their placement on the object, and the close-up of a wheel is localized at the wrong position on the car.
Symmetric objects produce doppelganger ambiguities, and the cameras of the grave monument are placed on the wrong one of its two identical pillars.
Objects far from the training distribution, such as the toy shark, whose appearance changes drastically with its pose and placement across the views, are reconstructed inconsistently.
blocks.zh:
失败案例。 图S2显示Spotter失败的4个搁置样本,每个最常见的故障模式各一个。
用长焦距拍摄的观点在焦距和深度之间模糊不清,因此它们的点可能与其他观点错位,并出现在飞机周围的噪音中.
特写视图在物体上的位置上可能模糊不清,一个轮子的特写是局部化的,在车上位置错误.
对称物体产生二重身模糊,墓碑的摄像头被放置在它两个相同的柱子中的一个错误的地方.
远离训练分布的物体,如玩具鲨,其外观随其姿势和不同观点的放置而急剧变化,其重建不连贯。

blocks.en: Appendix G LLM Prompts
blocks.zh: 附录G LLM 提示

blocks.en:
All three LLM passes of the curation use the same setup.
The model is Claude Opus 5, the system prompt is the rubric reproduced below, each user message contains a batch of 50 numbered categories, and the response is JSON constrained to a fixed schema.
On a hand-labelled set of 32 categories, the classification pass agreed with the labels on all 32 verdicts and on 14 of 15 granularity labels.
blocks.zh:
馆内三个LLM通行证都使用相同的设置.
型号为Claude Opus 5,系统提示是下面复制的标题,每个用户消息包含一组50个编号的类别,响应是JSON受固定的策略限制.
在一套手贴的32个类别上,分类通行证与所有32个裁定和15个颗粒性标签中的14个的标签一致。

blocks.en:
Category classification (Section 3.2 of the main paper).
The response for each category gives the verdict (keep, reject, or uncertain), the reject reason, the granularity (individual, model, named unknown, or pool), and whether the object is installed at a fixed site.
blocks.zh:
类别分类(主论文第3.2节)。
每个类别的响应给出了判断(保持,拒绝,或不确定),拒绝理由,颗粒性(个人,型号,命名未知,或池),以及物体是否安装在一个固定的站点.

blocks.en: You are classifying Wikimedia Commons category titles for a 3D object reconstruction dataset. Each category’s images will be used to reconstruct a rigid physical object with COLMAP. Your job is SUBJECT identity: decide from the title (plus its parent category and crawl root) whether the category is about physical objects suitable for reconstruction.
blocks.zh: 您正在将一个 3D 对象重建数据集的 Wikimedia Commons 分类标题 。 每个类别的图像将用来重建一个带有COLMAP的刚性物理对象. 您的工作是 SUBJECT 身份: 从标题( 加上其父类和 craw root) 决定该类别是否涉及适合重建的物理对象 。

blocks.en: Each numbered item gives:
blocks.zh: 每个编号的项目给出:

blocks.en: - the category TITLE (your main evidence),
blocks.zh: - TITLE(你的主要证据),

blocks.en: - parent: the category it was found under,
blocks.zh: - 父母:在下面找到的类别,

blocks.en: - root: the top-level category a breadth-first crawl started from to reach it. A hint only -- the crawl sometimes wanders, so an item may sit under an unrelated root. An off-root category of genuine physical objects is still a keep.
blocks.zh: - root:一个宽度第一爬行的顶级类别从到达它. 只有提示——爬行有时会徘徊,所以物品可能坐落在不相关的根下. 真正实物的离根类别仍然是保留。

blocks.en: - files: how many image files the category holds,
blocks.zh: - 文件:类别中有多少图像文件,

blocks.en: - wikidata: whether a Wikidata item is linked to it. A weak hint that the category names a recognized concept -- but concepts include generic types ("settee"), so it proves nothing about specificity.
blocks.zh: - wikidata:一个维基数据项是否与之相关. 一种微弱的暗示是,类名称是一个公认的概念——但概念包括通用类型("settee"),所以它没有证明任何关于特异性.

blocks.en: The pipeline tolerates noise but not wrongness: a rejected category is gone forever, while a wrongly kept one merely wastes a download before reconstruction discards it. When a title does not clearly establish a reject reason, KEEP it.
blocks.zh: 管道可以容忍噪音,但不能容忍错误:一个被拒绝的类别将永远消失,而一个错误地保留一个只是浪费一个下载,然后重建放弃它。 当标题没有明确确定拒绝理由时,保留它。

blocks.en: For each numbered item return:
blocks.zh: 每个编号项返回:

blocks.en: verdict:
blocks.zh: 判决:

blocks.en: - "keep" -- the category depicts physical, rigid objects (whatever family they belong to).
blocks.zh: -"保持"——该类描绘的是物理的,刚性的物品(无论属于哪个家族).

blocks.en: - "reject" -- the title alone establishes one of the reject reasons below.
blocks.zh: -"拒绝"——单是标题就确定了下面的拒绝理由之一.

blocks.en: - "uncertain" -- genuinely cannot tell what the category depicts.
blocks.zh: ——"不确定"——真正不能分辨类别所描绘的是什么.

blocks.en: reason (for reject; use "ok" when keep):
blocks.zh: (用于拒绝;保留时使用“ok”):

blocks.en: - "usage_or_provenance" -- photos taken WITH the object or sourced from somewhere: "Taken with Nikon D5300", "Photos from X stream", "Media from iNaturalist".
blocks.zh: -"使用_或_证明"——用物体拍摄的照片或来源于某处:"用Nikon D5300拍摄","X流照片","iNaturalist媒体".

blocks.en: - "people" -- people using/holding/wearing the object: "Guitarists with...", "People with Canon cameras".
blocks.zh: - "人"——使用/持有/佩戴物体的人:"Guitarists with...","people with Canon camera".

blocks.en: - "media_or_2d" -- depictions rather than the object: logos, icons, SVG, diagrams, drawings, paintings, stamps, advertisements, book titles, close-up detail shots.
blocks.zh: -"media_or_2d"——描写而非对象:标志,图标,SVG,图,图,图,画,邮票,广告,图书标题,特写细节镜头.

blocks.en: - "place_or_institution" -- a place, street, building, company, museum, maker, or event venue that merely contains the family noun: "Cannon Street station", "Scientific instrument makers".
blocks.zh: - "场所或机构"——仅包含家庭名词的场所,街道,建筑,公司,博物馆,制作者或活动场所:"坎农街站","科学仪器制造者".

blocks.en: - "event_or_activity" -- competitions, festivals, ceremonies, activities: "2019 ICF Canoe Slalom World Championships", "Emptying of post boxes".
blocks.zh: -"活动"-比赛,节日,仪式,活动:"2019ICF Canoe Slalom World Championships","推展邮箱".

blocks.en: - "abstract_or_meta" -- licenses, wiki maintenance, pronunciation audio, quality-image collections, categories-about-categories.
blocks.zh: -"abstract_or_meta" - 许可,维基维护,发音音频,质量图像集,类别-大约类别.

blocks.en: - "flat" -- near-planar subjects: manhole covers, coins, plaques, murals, signage, banknotes.
blocks.zh: -"平面"——近平面主题:盖子,硬币,牌匾,壁画,标志,钞票.

blocks.en: - "deformable_or_soft" -- clothing, uniforms, textiles, bags, plush.
blocks.zh: - "可变形_或_软"——服装,制服,纺织品,包,加.

blocks.en: - "parts_or_accessories" -- components rather than whole objects: "Guitar headstocks", "Camera parts", "Bicycle pannier racks" is a borderline whole object (keep); use this only for clear fragments of a larger object.
blocks.zh: -"parts_或_accessories" - 组件而不是整个对象:"吉他头部股票","卡美拉零件","Bicle plannier racks"是一个边线整体对象(keep);仅用于较大对象的清晰碎片.

blocks.en: - "other" -- a reject that fits none of the above (say nothing else; the verdict is what matters).
blocks.zh: - “其他”——一种不符合上述任何条件的拒绝(别无他法;判决才是关键)。

blocks.en: granularity (for keep; "n_a" for reject):
blocks.zh: 颗粒性( 用于保存; “n_ a” 用于拒绝):

blocks.en: - "individual" -- one specific physical object: "Penfold pillar box on Otterndorf Green, Sheringham", "USCGC White Pine (WLM-547)".
blocks.zh: -"个人"——一个特定的物理物体:"奥特恩多夫格林(英语:Otterndorf Green, Sheringham)上的Penfold柱盒","USCGC白松(英语:WLM-547)".

blocks.en: - "model" -- one manufactured design or standardized type whose units are geometrically interchangeable: "Fender Stratocaster", "K6 telephone boxes in Derbyshire", "Queen Elizabeth II type A/B red pillar boxes in Merseyside", "IBM Model M Keyboard". A place qualifier does not demote a model.
blocks.zh: -"模型"——一种制造设计或标准化型号,其单位几何可互换:"Fender Stratocaster","德比郡的K6电话箱","皇后伊丽莎白二世在默赛赛德的A/B型红色支柱箱","IBM Model M键盘". 地方修饰不会降级模型。

blocks.en: - "named_unknown" -- the title carries a proper-name or model-number token you do not recognize, modifying the family noun: "Parc Vue benches in New York City", "KX100 telephone boxes". An unfamiliar name is evidence of specificity -- never downgrade these to pool just because you don’t know the name.
blocks.zh: -"姓名不详"——标题带有你不认识的正名或型号符号,修改家族名词: "纽约市的Parc Vue长椅","KX100电话箱". 一个陌生的名字就是特异性的证据,

blocks.en: - "pool" -- a generic type, possibly place-scoped, containing many different designs: "Snowplows", "Settees", "Traffic bollards in Wuppertal", "Cannons in Florida", "Wooden benches". Also under-specified family names that span multiple geometries: "Glock" (17/19/26/43 differ), "King George V post boxes in the Republic of Ireland" (mixes wall-mounted and pillar).
blocks.zh: -"池"——一种通用型,可能为放置镜形,包含许多不同的设计:"雪犁","盘子","武珀塔尔的塔夫奇柱","佛罗里达的坎农","沃登长凳". 另外,横跨多个几何的规格不足的姓氏:"格洛克"(17/19/26/43不同),"爱尔兰共和国的国王乔治五世邮箱"(混合挂墙和柱子).

blocks.en: fixed_location (boolean): true if the objects are permanently installed at fixed sites (street furniture, installed fountains, monuments-like); false if portable/movable; judge from the object family when the title doesn’t say.
blocks.zh: 固定位置( boolean ): 如果物体永久安装在固定地点( 街道家具、 已安装的喷泉、 类似纪念碑) , 是否真实 ; 如果是可移动/ 可移动, 是否虚伪 ; 标题未表示时来自对象家族的法官 。

blocks.en: object_scale (boolean, for keep; use false for reject): a descriptive FLAG, never a reason to reject. True if the subject is hand-to-room scale -- a statue, gravestone, cannon, telescope on a mount, church organ. False if larger. The test: could a person walk around it and photograph the whole thing from a few metres? "Very Large Telescope" (an observatory site) -> false; "Zenit avtomat" (a camera) -> true. Large MOVABLE things -- ships, airliners, locomotives -- are false and that is fine; the flag records size only, and such categories are still kept. Obelisks and triumphal columns -> true; anything with interior rooms -> false.
blocks.zh: object_scale(布尔,用于保存;错误用于拒绝):一个描述性的FLAG,从不拒绝。 如果题材是手到室的尺度—— 雕像,墓碑,大炮,山上的望远镜,教堂的管风琴。 假的,如果更大的话。 测试:一个人能不能绕着它走,从几米远拍下整件事? "甚大望远镜"(一个天文台站点) - > 假;"Zenit avtomat"(一个照相机) - > 真. 大型移动物品 -- -- 船只、飞机、机车 -- -- 是虚假的,这很好;旗帜只记录大小,这些类别仍然保留。 方尖碑和胜利柱 - > 真实;任何有室内房间的东西 - > 虚假。

blocks.en: Different PHYSICAL UNITS of one design count as one object. A category like "Honda Accord Crosstour" contains photos of many distinct physical cars -- different owners, colors, countries -- yet it is ONE object for reconstruction, because every unit shares the same body shape. Likewise fifty K6 telephone kiosks across fifty towns are one "model". A category is never a pool merely because its photos show more than one physical specimen.
blocks.zh: 一个设计的不同PHYSICAL UNITS算作一个对象. 像"本田协议十字架"这样的类别包含了许多不同物理车体的照片——不同的车主,颜色,国家——然而它是重建的One对象,因为每个单位都拥有相同的车体形状. 同样地,50个城镇的50个K6电话亭是一个"模型". 一个类别从来不是一个池 仅仅因为它的照片 显示不止一个物理标本。

blocks.en: The line between "model" and "pool" is SHAPE, not appearance. Reconstruction only uses geometry: units that differ in color, finish, livery, trim, or wear but share one body shape are ONE model ("Fender Stratocaster" stays a model despite countless colors; "Red post boxes" pooled across designs is still a pool despite one color). A category is a pool only when the objects in it have materially different SHAPES -- different products, different size variants (Glock 17 vs 26), or a bare type noun spanning many designs. Minor sub-variant drift (a changed headstock logo, a facelifted grille) does not demote a model; a doubt about shape goes to "model", not "pool".
blocks.zh: "模型"和"池"之间的线条是SHAPE,而不是外观. 重建只使用几何:不同颜色,完成,活泼,修剪,或穿戴但共用一个身体形状的单位是One模型("Fender Stratocaster"尽管有无数颜色,仍保留一个模型;"红色邮箱"横跨设计集合仍是一个池,尽管有一个颜色). 一个类别只有在其中的物体在物质上与SHAPES-不同产品,不同大小的变体(Glock 17 vs 26),或光字名词跨越许多设计时,才是一个池. 细小的亚变异漂移(一个改变的头股标志,一个抬起的烤架)不会降级一个模型;对形状的怀疑会变成"模型",而不是"池".

blocks.en: Rules of thumb:
blocks.zh: 拇指规则 :

blocks.en: - Distinguish "type + place" pools from "named design + place" models by whether the pre-place part names a specific design (code, reign+type, brand+model) or a bare noun.
blocks.zh: - 区分"类型+地点"池与"命名设计+地点"模式,即前置部分是指定特定设计(代码,统治+类型,品牌+模式)的名称,还是赤裸的名词.

blocks.en: - A brand alone ("Zenit cameras") is a pool of that brand’s models -- keep, pool.
blocks.zh: - 独家品牌("Zenit camera")是该品牌模型的集合——保持,集合.

blocks.en: - Museum/display context does not reject an object category: "Torpedoes" in museums are still torpedoes. Only reject when the subject is the institution itself.
blocks.zh: ——博物馆/场景上下文并不拒绝某类物品:博物馆中的"Torpedoes"仍然是鱼雷. 只有在主体是机构本身时才拒绝.

blocks.en: - When two readings are plausible, keep it and give your best-guess granularity -- do not resolve doubt by rejecting.
blocks.zh: - 当两个读数可信时,保持它,并给出你最乐观的颗粒性 -- -- 不要通过拒绝来解决疑问。

blocks.en: sam_prompt -- ONE short generic noun phrase for the object class: "statue", "cannon", "gravestone", "pipe organ", "telephone box", "typewriter", "wind turbine". Rules:
blocks.zh: 秒数 - 对象类的一个简短的通用名词短语:"statue","cannon","gravestone","管风琴","电话箱","打字机","风轮机". 规则:

blocks.en: - Generic, never specific. "Bust of Voltaire" -> "bust". "Pentax K10D" -> "camera". "K6 telephone boxes in Derbyshire" -> "telephone box". Names, model numbers, places, and reigns never appear in the output.
blocks.zh: -普通的,从不具体 "伏尔泰巴士" - >"bust","Pentax K10D" - >"camera". "德比郡的K6电话箱" - >"电话箱". 名称,模型数字,地点和统治从未出现在输出中.

blocks.en: - Name the WHOLE object the category is about, not a component: "pipe organ" not "organ pipes"; "fountain" not "basin"; "cannon" not "cannon barrel".
blocks.zh: - 名称(WHOLE) 类别对象,而非组件:"管风琴"不是"器官管";"泉"不是"盆";"炮"不是"炮管".

blocks.en: - No material, color, pose, or style: "bronze equestrian statue" -> "statue". Those describe one instance; the same word must fit every unit in the category.
blocks.zh: - 怎么样? 没有材料,颜色,姿势,或风格:"青铜马术雕像" - >"Statue". 这说明一个情况;同一词必须适合这一类别的每一个单位。

blocks.en: - Two-word compounds are fine when a single word is wrong or too broad: "wayside cross", "baptismal font", "sewing machine", "vending machine".
blocks.zh: - 单词错误或太宽时,两字复合物是好的:"路面交叉","洗浴字体","缝合机","售货机".

blocks.en: ANCHOR TO THE CATEGORY TREE. The parent and root tell you the object’s family, and that is authoritative: everything under a "Dolmens" root is a dolmen, everything under "Pipe organs by country" is a pipe organ. Use the family’s noun unless the TITLE clearly names something more specific or different (a "War memorials" root can hold an obelisk, a statue, or a wall -- take the title’s word there). Root and parent names are index-shaped ("Coastal artillery", "War memorials by country") -- give the object noun ("cannon", "war memorial"), not the index name. Be CONSISTENT: every category in the same family should get the same word unless its title says otherwise.
blocks.zh: 进入类别里。 家长和根会告诉你对象的家庭,这是权威的:"斗门"根下的一切都是一个斗门,"按国家划分的皮佩器官"下的一切都是一个管风琴. 使用家族名词, 除非TITLE明确点出更具体或不同的名字(“战争纪念”根可以竖立方尖碑、雕像或墙壁, 根和父名为索引形("海岸炮兵","按国家划分的战争纪念")——给出对象名词("炮","战争纪念"),而不是索引名. 同一家庭的每个类别都应该得到同一个词,除非其标题另有说明。

blocks.en: alternatives -- normally an EMPTY list. Fill it ONLY when the title and the tree genuinely disagree about what the object is, or the title alone does not make the object clear (e.g. a battery site that could be read as guns, a bunker, or an installation). A synonym of your chosen word is NOT an uncertainty ("dolmen" is not unsure because "megalithic tomb" exists) -- never list synonyms. At most 2 entries. A non-empty list marks the item for human review, so listing alternatives "to be safe" defeats its purpose.
blocks.zh: 选项——通常为EMPTY列表。 只有在标题和树对物体是什么真正有分歧时才填充,或者仅标题并不能使物体清晰(例如,可以读作枪支、掩体或安装的电池址)。 你所选词的同义词不是不确定性("dolmen"不是不确定,因为"megalithic 墓"存在)——从不列出同义词. 最多两条 一份非空列表标志着该物品需要人类审查,因此列出"安全"的替代品会使其目的落空.

blocks.en: confidence -- "high" when the object class is clear from title + tree, "low" when you filled alternatives or the title does not make the object clear. Nothing else.
blocks.zh: 置信——当对象类从标题+树中清晰时为"高",当填充替代物或标题不能使对象清晰时为"低". 没有别的事
